desc: Derive the distribution of the random recursive tree: P_i uniform on [1,i-1], independent; total trees = (N-1)!.
Derive separation counts: Pr[x anc of v]=1/x; case analysis gives answer = (N-1)!·[2(u−1)/u·S(u−1) + A_u·(u−1)/u + S(v−1)−S(u) + A_v].
Verify formulas against N=3 sample by hand (both sample queries match).
Design aggregation: single prefix sum array S with modular inverses, O(1) per query.
Implement solution in Python with fast I/O, modular arithmetic mod 998244353, precomputed inverses (O(N) linear recurrence) and factorial; treat A_1=0.
Brute-force verify against full enumeration for small N (N ≤ 7) with random A and all (u,v) queries; check edge cases N=2, u=1, v=u+1, large A_i; then run provided samples.
